selector.rationale: Leptomeningeal lymphoma best explains the findings of lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features and κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation in the cerebrospinal fluid, along with diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and enhancement of cranial nerves on brain MRI.

rejected.label: Leptomeningeal metastasis
rejected.why: Lack of evidence for metastatic disease

rejected.label: Rituximab-related secondary lymphoma
rejected.why: Insufficient evidence to support rituximab as the cause of lymphoma

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: Less specific than leptomeningeal lymphoma for the presented findings

rejected.label: Central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: While a strong candidate, leptomeningeal lymphoma is more specific for the leptomeningeal involvement
